description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three distinct benchmarks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The horizontal axis lists the benchmarks, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70 with major ticks at intervals of 10. The legend indicates that the blue bars correspond to MMAU and the purple bars to MMAR. For the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of approximately 48%, while MMAR achieves about 30%. In the Audio-Reasoner benchmark, MMAU reaches an accuracy of approximately 61%, and MMAR reaches about 36%. For the Qwen-2.5-Omni benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of approximately 65%, and MMAR achieves about 56%. Across all three benchmarks, MMAU consistently demonstrates higher accuracy than MMAR.
